title: Auto Clear Cache
enableDesc: Runs on a schedule via chrome.alarms — not setInterval, so it still fires even if the service worker was suspended.

typeDesc.cache: Harmless — just means pages reload a bit slower the first time.
typeDesc.cookies: Signs you out of most sites.
typeDesc.history: Clears the list of pages you've visited.
typeDesc.downloadHistory: Only the LIST of downloads — not the files on your machine.

cookieWarning: Clearing cookies signs you out of most sites, including ones you didn't mean to.
excludedNote: Exclusion only works for cookies and cache on a specific domain — it does NOT work for browsing history, form data, or download history (a limitation of the browser itself).
